title: Freddy vs. Jason
review: Absolute trash. After the opening montage you're treated to the world's most trite horror movie setup. Just the most vanilla cast of high school slasher victims. Nothing of interest happens outside of the institutionalised duo, for the longest time. There's a bizarre teen corn field rave where everyone has glow sticks that don't work. I'm not expert in psychiatric care but Will has an incredibly clean shave for someone in that situation. Who does the patients haircuts? It's a big muddled mess of a film. Each scene doesn't feel very connected into the narrative, and the pacing is terrible. There's a completely unnecessary car crash where nobody is even remotely injured and they just forget it happened moments later. During the lightning storm they really overuse the flash lighting, and don't add any delay before the thunder, like I complained about with {Sleepy Hollow}. Trying to continue some sort of ongoing Elm Street story, during a monster crossover film, was a terrible idea. The kids mission also seemed pointless when the town's plan for containing Freddy was already effective, and it's only the protagonist's escape that caused issues in the first place. And then there's the cannabis issue: they don't bring its effect on dreams up, in a movie about trying to suppress dreams with drugs, where some of the characters are stoners. And then there's the U-bend issue: there are multiple scenes where pills fall down sink drains, and are assumed to be permanently lost. A lot happens in this film, but those things aren't very strongly connected, in terms of logic or editing flow, and none of it is very fun.
